dedupe_keys.name: networknature nature based solutions knowledge databases and project network map

description: NetworkNature publishes three linked databases on nature-based solutions and an interactive map of EU-funded projects. The knowledge gaps database compiles gaps identified in the evidence base for nature-based solutions to guide research, policy and practice. The database of EU research and innovation projects gathers NbS projects from BiodivERsA, Horizon 2020, FP7, Interreg and LIFE over 2011 to 2021. The Nature-based Solutions Facts database, described as a first prototype, holds evidence on the benefits, features and outcomes of NbS for environmental, societal and financial challenges. The project network map shows all EU-funded NbS projects and the ecosystems they work on, built from data created by IUCN Europe and displayed by Oppla. Caveats: the databases are browsable web tools without a documented download or licence, and coverage is limited to EU-funded projects. They help locate nature-based flood, heat and water measures and their evidence when choosing green-blue options in infrastructure resilience studies; a related record is the Oppla NbS repository.
